en: Color panoramic view of a mid‑20th‑century European city in a wide valley surrounded by high, steep mountains. The foreground shows residential houses with gardens and a railway line, while the middle ground contains a dense urban area with red‑tiled roofs and several mid‑rise modern buildings, including a prominent long, terraced office or civic building. In the distance, the city center with church towers and historic cores is visible. The background is dominated by dramatic rocky mountain walls under a blue sky. Two red hand‑drawn lines arc across the mountains, seemingly marking a route or geological feature. No printed caption or text is visible on the image side.
